The doctors and nurses were all incredibly kind, and the hospital was kept spotlessly clean. It's a wonderful hospital.

While out for a walk, my 7-month-old Pomeranian accidentally ate some tobacco leaves, and I panicked and called Shiki no Mori Animal Hospital.

Even though it was just a consultation call, they listened to the situation very carefully and kindly told me to "come in immediately just in case." I'm truly grateful that they were able to see my dog ​​just 10 minutes later, even without an appointment.

The doctor carefully examined and interviewed my dog, and when they induced vomiting, my dog ​​threw up far more tobacco leaves than I had imagined. Seeing that amount, I truly felt so glad that I had rushed to the hospital. I believe that my beloved dog's life was saved because they accepted him so quickly.

Not only the doctor, but also the nurses and reception staff were all very kind, and at the end, they even gave me a card with information on other hospitals that offer after-hours care, saying, "If your dog's condition changes again during the night, you can have him examined at this hospital as well." Their thoughtful consideration greatly eased my anxieties.

The clinic was very clean, and the staff were consistently polite and attentive. It's a hospital where you can entrust your pet with complete peace of mind.

I usually go to a different animal hospital, but I was truly impressed by their prompt and warm response this time. My dog ​​is now calm and relaxed.

Thank you so much for everything. If anything happens again, I would definitely like to use this wonderful animal hospital.

We are using this clinic for our cat.

The doctor is kind and answers all our concerns thoroughly. The nurses are cheerful and subtly make conversation to lift our spirits. I think it's a very well-balanced hospital.

What I would recommend most is the very spacious waiting room. There's enough space for two or three large dogs to wait comfortably, and in the case of our cat, even if there are other dogs or cats waiting, she doesn't get anxious or meow because of unfamiliar smells or presences. I think it's a big plus that they have that much space. Since our cat doesn't seem to be suffering, it's a great help for us owners as well, as the waiting time isn't a burden.

Please excuse this message. Chibi is 20 or 21 years old (she's actually a bit chubby). She came to our home alone, hopping in a car from Iwate. She grew up with the children and quickly surpassed them, becoming an elderly cat herself. We brought her here because she was suffering from a runny nose and difficulty breathing. After the New Year, her runny nose stopped completely, and we temporarily stopped going to the vet. However, due to her advanced age, her condition progressed from blood in her urine to kidney problems, and our family was worried about what to do, but we wanted her to rest peacefully at home. At the end of April, her condition suddenly changed, and she began to be unable to walk or eat or drink. By the beginning of May, she was bedridden. In the end, she crossed the rainbow bridge without suffering. I'm contacting you now that things have calmed down a bit, and I think Chibi is happy to receive such beautiful flowers. I am truly grateful to the cheerful staff and reliable doctor. Thank you very much. We have a younger brother of Chibi who didn't make the cut as a potential mate, so we will be in touch again.

Even though the cause of my pet's condition couldn't be clearly identified (the explanations were vague and difficult for a layman to understand), I followed all the instructions, such as various tests, X-rays, and injections. Ultimately, they couldn't pinpoint the exact cause or improve the condition. I was at a loss as to what to do without being told a treatment plan or detailed future plans. They offered to keep my pet if I was worried about taking it home. They suggested hospitalization (for ¥X million per night) and asked me to sign a consent form. It felt like they were just trying to get my money, and their answers about what to do next were so casual and unprofessional.
At that point, I decided I couldn't trust them and refused to hospitalize my pet, so I went home.
Later, when I consulted another veterinary clinic, they were able to quickly identify the cause, and they kindly explained what to do afterwards, and my pet recovered, all for a cheaper fee.
I won't be consulting them again.
They remembered my pet's name, and my dog ​​🐶 loves going to this vet. I'm grateful that they were able to help even in an emergency. …
👍👍👍The doctor was very good and professional, and helped a lot. …

My dog ​​always seems happy when I take him to the vet.
